title.zh: 假冒 Ledger 钓鱼网站登顶 Google 搜索结果，月访问量超 100 万次
title.en: Fake Ledger Phishing Site Tops Google Search Results with Over 1M Monthly Visits

current_state.zh:
据 Bitcoin News 报道，安全研究员 Cyber Scrilla 发现一个假冒 Ledger 的钓鱼网站及应用程序位居 Google 搜索结果顶部，Google 显示该站在过去 30 天内的访问量超过 100 万次。该页面意在诱骗用户提交其 24 个单词的助记词（恢复短语）。

Ledger 方面警告称，攻击者能够高度模仿其网站、内容和应用程序，诱使用户输入掌控自托管钱包的 24 个单词助记词。该钓鱼活动出现之际，另有一项针对与一家东南亚经销商相关、估计约 8600 万美元钱包失窃案的调查仍在进行中。

此次警示之前，网络安全公司 Zscaler 在 9 月的一项调查中发现，有恶意 Google 广告冒充 Ledger，并将用户重定向至虚假的钱包验证页面。来源未报告该具体钓鱼活动造成的已确认损失。
current_state.en: Security researcher Cyber Scrilla uncovered a fraudulent Ledger phishing site and app ranking atop Google Search results, logging more than 1 million visits in 30 days to trick users into surrendering their 24-word recovery phrases.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Security researcher Cyber Scrilla uncovered a fraudulent Ledger phishing site and app ranking atop Google Search results, logging more than 1 million visits in 30 days to trick users into surrendering their 24-word recovery phrases.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Security researcher Cyber Scrilla uncovered a fraudulent Ledger phishing site and app ranking atop Google Search results, logging more than 1 million visits in 30 days to trick users into surrendering their 24-word recovery phrases.
updates.background_zh: Ledger 的支持文档指出，其用户持续在社交媒体、搜索引擎和电子邮件中遭遇钓鱼攻击。与此同时，Ledger 正在调查潜在的硬件钱包篡改问题：有报道称，与东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis 所售设备相关的数百个钱包中，可能有逾 8600 万美元加密资产被盗，相关报道提及的估算区间约为 7200 万至 9300 万美元。据以太坊链上记录，MistTrack 标记为与 CryptoBilis／Ledger 窃案相关的一个钱包在 10 月 10 日通过 23 笔交易将 464 ETH 转入 Tornado Cash。
updates.background_en: Ledger's support documentation states that its users are continuously targeted by phishing attacks on social media, search engines and via email. Separately, Ledger is investigating potential wallet tampering after reports that more than $86 million in crypto may have been stolen from hundreds of wallets linked to devices sold by CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller; reporting cited estimates ranging from roughly $72 million to $93 million. A wallet linked by MistTrack to the CryptoBilis/Ledger thefts routed 464 ETH into Tornado Cash in 23 deposits on Oct. 10, according to Ethereum records.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此事的传导渠道是用户层面的安全与对自托管硬件钱包的信心，而非任何协议、交易所或代币敞口，因为事件未涉及任何智能合约或交易场所。它再次凸显：对自托管持有者而言，助记词被盗而非协议漏洞，仍是主要的资产损失途径。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel here is user-level security and sentiment toward self-custody hardware wallets rather than any protocol, exchange or token exposure, since no smart contract or venue is implicated. It reinforces the operational risk that recovery-phrase theft, not protocol exploits, remains the main loss vector for self-custody holders.
